subject: Renewal: TideWave Dedicated Pool + Throughput SLA — concession request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Li <bethany@tidewave.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal proposal: TideWave Dedicated Pool + throughput SLA

Hi Bethany —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is the renewal SOW for the 12-month reserved pool plus the additional 8 A100 GPUs you requested (so total reserved capacity of 24 A100-equivalent GPUs). The key commercial points in this draft:

- Base renewal term: 12 months, auto-renew
- Additional reserved capacity: +8 GPUs (billed monthly as part of reserved pool)
- Throughput target: 150M tokens/day aggregated; we propose a 99th percentile latency SLO of 120ms for gen workloads on the reserved pool tier
- Price: listed in the SOW (line-item for new GPUs)

I've also attached your Q1 token usage export for quick reference. If the throughput SLO or credits are must-haves for TideWave to move forward, please flag and we can escalate internally.

Next steps: once you confirm the SOW we can push the order to procurement and draft a shortened PO.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Bethany Li <bethany@tidewave.ai>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@tidewave.ai>, Rajesh Khanna <rajesh.k@tidewave-ai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-31T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: TideWave Dedicated Pool + throughput SLA

Marissa — thanks for the draft. A couple of points from the TideWave side before we sign:

1) Pricing: the incremental cost for the +8 GPUs is higher than we modelled. Given this is during renewal and we're committing 12 months, we need a concession — target of a 30% one-time credit applied to the first invoice for the added capacity (or equivalent monthly ramp across Q1).

2) SLA/guarantees: we appreciate the listed SLO. We need a stronger operational guarantee (credit tied to missed throughput floor). Can you confirm a remediation path (burst capacity or fallback model) if 150M tokens/day is missed for two consecutive weeks?

3) Procurement needs a PO template; can you send a line-item invoice we can attach to our PO?

We attached our usage and a short internal note. Happy to discuss on a quick call — Bethany will be out Wed-Fri next week but Rajesh can cover.

Thanks,
Bethany
Head of Platform, TideWave

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal: TideWave Dedicated Pool + throughput SLA — requesting concession approval

Internal — forwarding TideWave ask. They want a 30% one-time credit on the incremental GPUs or a ramped credit across Q1, and a stronger operational remediation path for missed throughput. Procurement also wants a PO line-item.

Notes: long-standing account, usage growth is healthy (see attached CSV), but margin impact if we give full 30%. Karthik — you're owner on this account. Recommend we propose a middle ground concession to keep them in the pool during renewal.

Can finance sign off on 25% credit or do we need exec sign-off for anything above 20%? If we commit to a remediation path, we should define the terms: 5% monthly credit if throughput floor missed for 2 consecutive weeks, capped at two payments.

Marissa
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal: TideWave — concession sizing suggestion

Agree we should be flexible here. Quick input from GTM:
- Approve up to 20% one-time credit without exec review (Finance OK)
- For 21-30% we need an escalation note to Revenue Ops + FP&A; recommend we offer 25% one-time credit plus a 6-week performance review clause instead of open remediation credits. That reduces open-ended liability and gives an operational cadence.

Suggested language for customer-facing: offer 25% one-time credit on incremental capacity (applied to first invoice), include a documented operating playbook (fallback to capacity surge or prioritized burst queues) and a 6-week SLA review. If SLA misses occur after review, then propose a capped remediation of up to 5% invoice credit for two billing periods.

If you both agree, Karthik can send this as the formal concession.

— Aditya
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Li <bethany@tidewave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@tidewave.ai>
Date: 2027-04-02T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal proposal: TideWave Dedicated Pool + throughput SLA

Hi Bethany —

Thanks for the clear ask and for attaching the usage/PO intent. After internal review, we can offer the following concession to help move the renewal across the line:

1) Commercial concession: 25% one-time credit applied to the first invoice covering the incremental +8 GPUs (this reduces your first-month line-item for the added capacity).

2) Operational guarantees: we will commit to the 150M tokens/day throughput target and provide a documented operating playbook that includes prioritized burst queues and a standby burst pool for urgent spikes. If TideWave experiences a throughput shortfall for two consecutive weeks during the first 6 weeks post-launch, we'll execute an operational remediation plan and provide a remediation credit up to 5% of that month’s invoice, capped at two billing periods.

3) Review cadence: a 6-week post-launch review with our SRE/product operations to tune batching/quant profiles and confirm steady-state.

4) Procurement: attached is a line-item invoice table we can use for your PO; Marissa will follow up with the SOW revision and an updated invoice.

Please reply with confirmation and we’ll get the updated SOW and invoice over today so procurement can issue a PO.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
